full_page.content:
c. 1942, December
The following is a faithful transcription of photo copies of messages written on Christmas cards to his brother James Casey and family by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
1. c. Christmas 1942
God bless you dear Brother James,
I wrote Mrs. Baker and Mary of your difficulties but that you were keeping up. So do keep up as long as the dear Good God wills. But of course avoid anxiety - what glory that will be for each of us in eternity, just, in the end to have been able to say "Thou knowest 0 Jesus! Thy will be done."
Fr. Solanus.
2.
c. 1945, December
Mrs. Aurelia Herkenrath Overlake Drive Rt. 1. Bellevue, Washington
A Joyous, Blessed Christmas-tide to all at Lake Washington, Seattle.
Praised be Jesus and our Blessed Mother Mary who gave Him to us - and through Him became our own Blessed Mother Mary.
Fr. Solanus OFM Cap.
Original in possession of: Mrs. Aurelia Herkenrath Overlake Drive Rt. 1 Bellevue, Washington
